transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Mara, the Touring Show Producer. As we get closer to Saturday's one-night performance at Harbor Arena, I want to make sure we're on track with the load-in plan. I know the current draft uses a single-piece scenic arch, unloads from the arena dock, and calls for a general stagehand crew. Before I can approve the final plan and issue trucking instructions and crew calls, I need to conduct the standard pre-event check-in with venue technical management and production management. Can someone bring me up to speed on where things stand right now?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Mara, I need to flag a critical issue before you approve the plan. I received the arena's certified access measurements from facilities this morning — the dock door is 2.4 meters wide, but the single-piece scenic arch crate is 2.6 meters wide. The arch won't fit through the dock door as a single piece, so it must be transported as a sectional arch and brought through the ground-level dock rather than the freight elevator. This certificate arrived after the draft load-in plan was circulated, so it's not yet in the production file. The current draft plan will need to be revised before approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Mara, before you finalize anything, I need to share what I confirmed with the arena labor steward this afternoon. The labor agreement requires exactly six arena stagehands, with a call from 7:00 AM to 1:00 PM, and it prohibits the touring crew from self-unloading the trucks. I haven't logged the confirmation yet because the steward returned it after our daily production meeting. This directly affects the crew call and trucking instructions, so it needs to be factored into the revised plan alongside Dev's dock door issue.
